description: Generic Sega Game Gear game profile. Same control surface as SMS plus the handheld Start button.

confirm.hint: Press 2. Primary action in most Game Gear titles; advance menus.

menu.hint: Press Start. Title screen / soft pause; few Game Gear titles have a true pause menu.

nav_up.hint: Walk / move up. In menus: cursor up.

nav_down.hint: Walk / move down. In menus: cursor down.

nav_left.hint: Walk / move left. In menus: cursor left.

nav_right.hint: Walk / move right. In menus: cursor right.

notes: Game Gear is essentially a portable SMS; many titles share the same control conventions. Per-game profiles are a good idea when a title has unusual button uses.
